title: Atlas report
author: Atlas core
description: Read Atlas's own figures as a report a task form's chart draws (ADR-0555): the instances per process (instances-summary), one process measured over a period or bucket by bucket — day, week or month — (process-statistics), the open incidents per process and step (incident-summary), and the catalogue's delivery promises kept per product (delivery-report). A model names the Worker, the operation and one input object; which Atlas server answers and the technical account's API token live in the Worker and the vault and reach only the worker. The report is a snapshot in the contract atlas.report/1, taken when the task runs, and an ordinary instance variable, so a completed task still shows what its recipient saw. A refusal for want of a role is the BPMN error ATLASREPORT_REFUSED and a process that is not deployed ATLASREPORT_NOT_FOUND, each thrown only where the process catches it.

properties.label: Worker
properties.description: Name of the configured Atlas report Worker (Console → Workers) the task reads through, never a credential.

choices.name: Measure one process over a period

properties.label: Input
properties.description: One JSON object; a value may be an =expression. instances-summary and incident-summary: optionally process, title, language. process-statistics: process, and optionally from, to, buckets with bucket (day, week, month), title, language. delivery-report: optionally catalog, from, to, title, language. from and to are a date or RFC 3339 with an offset; language is de or en.

properties.label: Result variable
properties.description: Receives the report (atlas.report/1), which a chart component of a task form names as its key. Required on every operation.
